groups.title: Host settings schema on client definitions and one sourceControlHosts key
groups.why: makeProviderSettingsSchema/readSourceControlHostSettings in source-control-core, the contracts settings key change, and the shared settings patch merge.

groups.title: Generic secret storage and legacy-key migration in server settings
groups.why: serverSettings.ts drops the Bitbucket/GitHub-specific secret code for one path, plus the migration; sourceControlHostSecrets.ts is the new helper; the settings tests are rewritten.

groups.title: Bitbucket and GitHub declare their settings and read the new key
groups.why: Each host's definition declares its schema; server code and tests read settings via the new key; client-runtime exposes readGitHubSettings.

groups.title: Settings page renders host forms from their schema
groups.why: ProviderSettingsForm gains secret fields, SourceControlHostSettings is new, Bitbucket's hand-written form is deleted, GitHub panels read the new key, search entries are generated per host.

groups.title: GitCafe Token setting
groups.why: GitCafe declares a Token field, credentials prefer it over CAFE_TOKEN, discovery receives it; server tests mock the new credentials service.

groups.title: User guide updates
groups.why: Bitbucket and GitCafe sections of the source control guide.

notes: Hand-written by reading the PR description and diff, at file granularity: a reviewer-style split of one large refactor. Subjective; another reviewer could merge schema+server or split the UI.
Everything references the same new names (sourceControlHosts, settings schema), so the graph is dense: the challenge is splitting, not linking.
